notes.title: Update Notes for v0.7.9 - Warehouses and Lighting Bug Fix
notes.notes:
This is a very small update that adds a new map with some empty warehouse style stages.  This update also addresses a bug where certain lights wouldn't spawn correctly in Third Person mode.

Unofficially, I am developing an Unreal Engine 5 version of Cine Tracer.  My previous attempt didn't become an actual release but the new version is looking promising.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: MetaHuman Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to Cine Tracer v0.7.5!  This update adds 10 MetaHumans that are semi customizable and updates the game engine to Unreal Engine 4.27.2.  For a walk through on how to pose the MetaHumans and change their clothing please watch the update video on YouTube.

[previewyoutube=sHpqTieWtTg;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a major update and there are some changes to be noted:

1.  This update changed how assets are loaded at run time.  For now we have disabled "Character Building" with the [1-5] Hotkeys.  This functionality will be updated in future updates.  Please use "Editor" building for now.

2.  Many assets have been removed.  If you are in production and want to work on older project, please download the "v0_63" beta branch.  The YouTube video linked to this update shows the process.  Also please backup your project folder in general.

3.  Legacy Cameras, some props, and all characters except "Stand Ins" have been removed in this build.

The memory footprint of the app has been refactored and this build has been confirmed to work on older iMacs as well as the newer M1 Apple laptops.  For PC, 4GB of VRAM is still recommended.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: Cine Tracer v0.5 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=9T6XCzJti5o;full][/previewyoutube]

Cine Tracer v0.5 is a very big update.  Please watch the YouTube video for a very thorough explanation of the development direction and overview of the new workflow.  There are also several video explaining how to build with the new system.

Mac OS
If you have Mojave/Catalina, make sure you install the 64bit Steam client.  I have update the launch settings so Steam should recognize Cine Tracer a 64 bit app.  People were also reporting that launching Cine Tracer directly from the .app was working too.

Windows
If you are on an older system and or want to use Direct 11 for better performance, you can add "-dx11" into the Custom Launch Options in Steam.  If you have a modern GPU and want to use Ray Tracing, you will default be using DirectX12.  I will work on a simpler way of switching between DirectX version, but currently I'm not sure how to do that.

Old Save Files
Cine Tracer v0.34 will be available as a "Beta Branch" on Steam if you want to open older files or use the older maps that were in that release.  You are able to download the latest version any time after but opting out of that beta.

If you have any issues feel free to reach out on Instagram/Twitter/YouTube.  I do not have the time currently to properly support the game on Steam or via email etc.

Lots of Tutorials were produced for this update on YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/cinetracer

Cheers,

Matt
